title: Prisoners Dilemma
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prisoners
learningObjectives: Identify the two strategies available to each prisoner, Remain Silent (cooperate) and Confess (defect), and locate the resulting outcome in the 2x2 payoff grid
Explain why Confess is the dominant strategy for each prisoner regardless of what the other prisoner chooses
Distinguish the mutual-defection Nash equilibrium from the mutual-cooperation outcome that yields a better result for both players
Predict which cell of the payoff grid the red highlight will land on for a given pair of button presses
Evaluate how the dilemma explains real-world situations where individually rational choices produce a collectively worse outcome
